purpose: Closing author portrait in the animated book preview on slide S53
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: photorealistic cutout portrait for the closing slide of Marco Cremaschi’s educational presentation.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and the sole identity reference. Preserve the same adult man, his recognizable facial structure, brown eyes, full beard, salt-and-pepper short hair, septum ring and ear plugs. Ignore all background objects, documents and text in the reference; none should appear in the output.
Primary request: restyle this man in a plain black mock turtleneck (Italian lupetto), wearing small thin round wire-frame glasses like Steve Jobs’s signature glasses. Pose him in the iconic thoughtful portrait position: facing the camera, a relaxed closed-mouth expression, one hand supporting the chin with the index finger resting naturally along the cheek. This remains Marco, not Steve Jobs: do not replace his face, remove his beard, change his age or recede his hairline.
Style: realistic black-and-white studio portrait, natural skin and beard detail, soft directional key light, clear separation and subtle highlights on the black fabric, calm confident expression. No plastic skin or exaggerated retouching.
Composition: vertical 1024x1536, waist-up portrait including complete hair, both shoulders and the hand and forearm; modest transparent margins. Keep the face unobstructed by glasses reflections and keep the fingers anatomically natural.
Background: genuinely transparent with an actual alpha channel. No backdrop, no white rectangle, no gradient, no halo, no cast shadow, no text, logos, border or watermark.

bookPages.note: The portrait is a closing page of the animated preview.
